_note: Programmatically discovered (see 01-07-SUMMARY.md). Action 0 (N) is a guaranteed no-op against the boundary wall from the (1,1) start. Actions 1-12 are a feature-avoiding BFS path (blocking dot/trap/chest/tele/climb/gorge as intermediate cells, since those domains are not yet ported) from (1,1) to floor 1's exit tile, passing through exactly one door-direction-validated one-way door before descending to floor 2. Actions 13-100 bounce between floor 2's start (1,1) and its first backtracker-carved neighbor (guaranteed feature-free) to reach exactly 100 cumulative steps, triggering newDay/upkeep on the 100th move. Seed 256 was chosen because its 8-hour wandering-monster check on that first day draws zero 1s on d20, so state.combat stays null on both the engine and the frozen prototype (wandering-monster combat start is out of scope until 01-08).

floorFeatureShift.rationale: USER RULING D/G (Phase 54-07 fit, BAND-02, 2026-09-21): ENCOUNTER_DOTS fitted to { base: 7, perDepth: 0.3 } (from identity { base: 9, perDepth: 1 }) changes difficultyCurve(depth).dots — genFloor's feature-scatter loop (engine/maze.js) walks the SAME rng.shuffle(far) result but assigns the first `dots` array slots to the 'dot' feat before moving on to tele/chest/trap/climb/gorge, so a smaller `dots` count shifts EVERY later feature category's starting index by the same delta, remapping which cells land on 'tele'/'chest'/'trap'/'climb'/'gorge'/null — the rng cursor itself is UNCHANGED (rng.shuffle(far) runs once regardless of dots; the loop below it draws no further rng), so this is a pure, deterministic re-mapping, not new randomness. Measured live by walking this fixture's own 101-move script action-by-action (both floor 1 at boot and floor 2 after the depth-1->2 descend, action 12) and diffing floor.g[y][x].feat cell-for-cell against the frozen prototype; the fixture's own script deliberately avoids every dot/trap/chest/tele/climb/gorge cell as an intermediate step (see this file's _note), so none of these 13-per-depth remapped cells are ever visited by the move script itself — this declaration exists purely so the boot/per-action FULL floor.g comparison (which the test performs on principle, not because the script visits these cells) stays green.

divergence.rationale: USER RULING D/G (Phase 54-07 fit, BAND-02, 2026-09-21): HERO_SP_SCALE fitted to 0.28 scales the descend SP bonus (heroSpFor, engine/movement.js#descend) awarded when action 12 steps onto floor 1's exit tile (round(70*0.28)=19.6, rounds to 20). No further SP-granting action occurs in this 101-move script (no kill, no parley), so both sides hold steady at their own value (70 vs 20) through action 100. Measured live by walking the fixture's own script action-by-action on both the frozen prototype sandbox and the engine, never hand-typed.
